ti:work.ti:title: Scholia on Book 1 of Apollonius' Argonautica

ti:commentary.ti:label: Wendel's Scholia on Book 1 of Apollonius' Argonautica
ti:commentary.ti:description: Carolus Wendel's 1935 edition of the ancient Greek scholia on Book 1 of Apollonius Rhodius' Argonautica, including source and critical notes principally in Latin.

ti:edition.ti:label: Apollonii Rhodii Argonautica, edited by R. C. Seaton
ti:edition.ti:description: R. C. Seaton's Oxford Classical Text of the Argonautica, with a concise critical apparatus. Oxford: Clarendon Press, 1900.

ti:translation.ti:label: The Argonautica, translated by R. C. Seaton
ti:translation.ti:description: R. C. Seaton's English translation of Apollonius Rhodius, published by Harvard University Press in 1912.
